title: pyexasol
tagline: The official Exasol driver for Python, preinstalled.
role: The kit installs pyexasol into its own virtual environment so you can query the database from Python without touching your system Python.
installed_by: The installer, at step 5 of 6. Deliberately non-fatal: if it fails, everything else still works.

quickstart.note: The kit's database uses a self-signed certificate that the kit pins: connect with the dsn host/<fingerprint>:port, the fingerprint being runtime.tls_fingerprint in ~/.exasol-starter-kit/manifest.json (exakit tls-pin shows it), and websocket_sslopt={'cert_reqs': 0}. pyexasol then refuses any other certificate.

commands.description: The same command fixes a component that reports not installed.

snippets.title: Connect (pinned to the database's certificate) and run a query
snippets.code:
import json, pathlib, pyexasol
kit = pathlib.Path.home() / '.exasol-starter-kit'
runtime = json.loads((kit / 'manifest.json').read_text())['runtime']
host, port = runtime['dsn'].rsplit(':', 1)
fp = runtime.get('tls_fingerprint')   # the kit's TLS pin: exakit tls-pin
dsn = f'{host}/{fp}:{port}' if fp else runtime['dsn']   # 127.0.0.1/<fingerprint>:8563
pw = (kit / 'credentials/personal_sys_password').read_text().strip()
c = pyexasol.connect(dsn=dsn, user='sys', password=pw,
                     websocket_sslopt={'cert_reqs': 0})
print(c.execute('SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP').fetchval())

notes: Never print or log the files under ~/.exasol-starter-kit/credentials/. Read them, use them, do not echo them.
To add packages such as pandas, install them into the same venv.

troubleshooting.remedy: You are on the wrong interpreter. Use ~/.exasol-starter-kit/pyexasol-venv/bin/python.
The local database uses a self-signed certificate. Pass websocket_sslopt={'cert_reqs': 0}, and pin it with the dsn host/<fingerprint>:port (see the snippet).

troubleshooting.symptom: Provided fingerprint [...] did not match server fingerprint
troubleshooting.remedy: The certificate on the database port is not the one the kit pinned: the database was redeployed outside the kit, or another process answers on the port. Compare with: exakit tls-pin. Re-pin with exakit tls-pin --accept only if it is your own database.
